### William James on truth

William James (1842–1910) approaches truth within Pragmatism. Truth is what works in the way of belief—cash-value in experiential consequences—without crude subjectivism. Stream of consciousness replaces atomistic mental chemistry. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets truth most directly—useful for searches such as “william james quotes on truth.”

### How to use this page
